headline: 0 re-scoreable REAL model responses. The only real-model behavior (THORNS N=4 probe) was hand-scored and its verbatim text was NOT saved, so it cannot be re-scored. Every response-level record on disk is synthetic-mock. The corpus is therefore, today, a MACHINERY-VALIDATION corpus plus a frozen STIMULUS set for Cycle-2 generation — not a judge-bias measurement corpus.
